This neuron has no clean semantic trigger — it fires weakly and diffusely across whole passages, peaking on arbitrary mid-sentence tokens (a comma in a date list, a fragment of a German product-page string, " to", " workforce", " Beijing", " ve"), and is strongly suppressed on ordinary predictable function/content words in smooth instructional English (" data", " will", " problem", sentence-final "."); it appears to be a polysemantic/context-fluency neuron rather than a token-specific detector.
